```{r lfc-setup, include=FALSE}
# rna_02_lfc_report.Rmd
# HTML report generated by rna_02.1_lfc.R via rmarkdown::render();
# uses the variables of that script (RECEPTOR, CELL_LINE, OUT_PREFIX...) and reads
# tables and figures from results/<RECEPTOR>/<CELL_LINE>/. Not run on its own.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,
                      fig.align="center", dpi=150)
library(dplyr); library(knitr); library(kableExtra)

fmt_tbl <- function(df, caption=NULL)
  df |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) |>
  kable(caption=caption) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)

res_dir <- here::here("results", RECEPTOR, CELL_LINE)
fig_dir <- file.path(res_dir, "figures")
tab_dir <- file.path(res_dir, "tables")
lfc     <- read.csv(file.path(tab_dir, "02_lfc_master_table.csv"), check.names=FALSE)
```

> **Threshold:** |LFC| ≥ `r LOGFC_THRESHOLD` · **Comparison:** Resistance vs Parental (mean log2CPM)

## Classification summary

```{r lfc-summary}
cls <- lfc |> count(Classification) |>
  mutate(Pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
fmt_tbl(cls, "Gene classification")
```

## Top genes {.tabset}

### Top 15 Upregulated

```{r top-up}
lfc |> filter(Classification=="Upregulated") |>
  arrange(desc(LFC_Res_vs_Par)) |> slice_head(n=15) |>
  dplyr::select(Gene, LFC_Res_vs_Par, Mean_Expr_Par, Mean_Expr_Res) |>
  fmt_tbl("Top 15 Upregulated")
```

### Top 15 Downregulated

```{r top-down}
lfc |> filter(Classification=="Downregulated") |>
  arrange(LFC_Res_vs_Par) |> slice_head(n=15) |>
  dplyr::select(Gene, LFC_Res_vs_Par, Mean_Expr_Par, Mean_Expr_Res) |>
  fmt_tbl("Top 15 Downregulated")
```
